race.comment: MYSTRIX (10) is the one to beat after closing into second at this track over 1200m, beaten just under a length despite beginning awkwardly and being bumped approaching the 800m. She has placed at both previous tries around 1350m, gets a 2kg claim and already has the recent edge over CELTIC BHOY. On top. CELTIC BHOY (2) is the main danger after covering ground when fourth here last start, beaten just under two lengths, and his Morphettville Mdn third two back gives him enough substance, though he has yet to win at this trip. Can contest. MEAN MAZZLE (3) has placed in three of five and was third at Balaklava as a well-supported favourite, but the four-length margin means he still has a bit to do. Don't discount. WILD IS THE WIND (5) has kicked off his career with two seconds, including last start when second at this track over 1600m on soft going. Should be at his top and appeals as a leading player.
